name: Daraba
subtitle: Daraba is an okra sauce; in the version presented by the province of N'Djamena at the Festival Dary 5 in January 2024, called “moula Daraba Akhadar”, it was prepared with beef.

facts.label: What it is
facts.value: An okra sauce (sauce de gombo), presented as “moula Daraba Akhadar”.

facts.label: Where it was shown
facts.value: Among the most emblematic dishes presented by the province of N'Djamena at the Festival Dary 5.

parts.text: Daraba is an okra sauce; in the version presented by the province of N'Djamena at the Festival Dary 5 in January 2024, called “moula Daraba Akhadar”, it was prepared with beef.
It was served with a maize boule (a stiff maize-flour paste).
